logline: A fictional notes app shows a three-step habit that stops ideas getting lost.

hook.opening: Scattered chat bubbles fly in while the narrator asks whether you keep losing your best ideas.

beats.summary: Name the pain: ideas lost in random chats.
Save and try it for a week.

characters.acting_baseline: Warm, quick, slightly amused; leans on the numbers; never salesy.

visual_plan: Dark surface, one warm accent. Each spoken keyword lands on screen as it is said; steps build as a checklist; end card repeats the CTA.
